proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x y z
  have key : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2) * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2) - (a * x + b * y + c * z) ^ 2 = (a * y - b * x) ^ 2 + (b * z - c * y) ^ 2 + (a * z - c * x) ^ 2 := by
    ring
  have h1 := sq_nonneg (a * y - b * x)
  have h2 := sq_nonneg (b * z - c * y)
  have h3 := sq_nonneg (a * z - c * x)
  constructor
  · intro h
    have e1 : (a * y - b * x) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have e2 : (b * z - c * y) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have e3 : (a * z - c * x) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have f1 : a * y - b * x = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).1 e1
    have f2 : b * z - c * y = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).1 e2
    have f3 : a * z - c * x = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).1 e3
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩
    rw [sub_eq_zero.2 g1, sub_eq_zero.2 g2, sub_eq_zero.2 g3] at key
    linarith
